worlds.label: Citadel at the End of Time

events.label: 2012 Loki escapes with Tesseract — nexus
events.description: During the battle of New York, Loki grabs the glowing blue cube that lets him teleport, and slips away through a doorway - vanishing into history where he should never be.

events.label: TVA arrests Variant Loki
events.description: Officers from the Time Variance Authority, a grey bureaucracy that polices history, pluck Loki out of the past and arrest him for stepping off the path history was meant to follow.

events.label: Reset charges prune minor branches
events.description: The TVA shows Loki how it deals with unauthorised history: agents stamp small, stray branches of events out of existence with hand-held devices.

events.label: Hunt for Sylvie across apocalypses
events.description: Loki joins a TVA agent, Mobius, to track a fugitive who has been hiding at the ends of the world in moments just before civilisations are wiped out.

events.label: Roxxcart / Lamentis nexus blooms
events.description: The fugitive, a woman calling herself Sylvie, is cornered in a supermarket and then on a doomed moon - and in each desperate moment, new histories suddenly sprout around her and Loki.

events.label: Loki pruned to Void
events.description: Betrayed and scattered, Loki is struck by a TVA weapon that erases its victim, and he wakes in a wasteland at the end of time rather than simply ceasing to be.

events.label: Void: pruned variants / Alioth
events.description: In the wasteland, Loki finds generations of other erased versions of himself, all hiding from a colossal smoke monster that devours everything it catches.

events.label: Enchant Alioth; reach Citadel
events.description: Sylvie joins Loki and uses her power to reach into the monster's mind, holding it still long enough for the two of them to slip past it to a distant citadel.

events.label: He Who Remains explains Sacred Timeline
events.description: Beyond the monster waits a cheerful, unassuming man who reveals he has been quietly steering all of history along a single safe path to prevent a war among his own many selves.

events.label: Sylvie kills He Who Remains
events.description: Against his warnings and Loki's protests, Sylvie shoots the man who kept history on one line, taking her revenge and letting every version of history loose at once.

events.label: Multiverse unleashed — branches infinite
events.description: With the keeper gone, history splits endlessly at every turn - countless parallel versions of reality now grow unchecked from every choice.

events.label: Variant Loki captured by TVA
events.description: The fugitive Loki of 2012 is caught by the Time Variance Authority, the strange office that insists his escape was never supposed to happen.

events.label: He Who Remains killed; branches unbound
events.description: The hidden ruler of the timeline is killed, and the single authorised version of history breaks apart into countless free-growing branches.

events.label: Loki becomes living loom/Yggdrasil
events.description: Loki takes it upon himself to hold every diverging version of history together personally, becoming a living tree whose branches are all the timelines that might be.

events.label: Loki variant arrives at TVA
events.description: Loki, on the run after the battle of New York, is captured by the Time Variance Authority and put on trial for crimes against the proper flow of history.

events.label: Sacred Timeline pruning explained
events.description: The TVA explains its creed: only one version of history is allowed, and agents erase any diverging version by cutting it off with their weapons.

events.label: Sylvie counterpart alliance/romance
events.description: Loki meets Sylvie, a woman who is another version of himself, and the two move from wary enemies to allies - and eventually fall in love.

events.label: Alioth at End of Time
events.description: At the very end of time, the erased are hunted by Alioth, a monstrous storm-cloud creature that consumes everything cut off from history.

events.label: Sylvie kills He Who Remains
events.description: Sylvie kills the mysterious man behind the whole TVA, ignoring his warning that doing so will unleash a far worse fate on all of existence.

events.label: Timeline branches explode
events.description: With the one approved version of history gone, timelines multiply wildly and threaten to reignite a devastating multiverse war.

events.label: Temporal loom crisis S2
events.description: In the second series, the machine that weaves history together begins to overload, and the TVA races to keep it from melting down and destroying every timeline.

events.label: Loki replaces loom; holds branches
events.description: When the machine can no longer cope, Loki sacrifices his freedom: he sits at the centre of time, physically holding every world line together like a living tree, alone forever.

ruleEffects.effect: TVA reset sends variant to Void

outcome.summary: Sacred Timeline enforcement ends; multiverse branches freely after He Who Remains dies.
